newsitem.title: USA: Sonat asks CEO Kuehn to stay on until 2001.
newsitem.headline: Sonat asks CEO Kuehn to stay on until 2001.

text.p: Sonat Inc said on Monday that its directors have asked chairman and chief executive Ronald Kuehn Jr. to remain in his current posts until April 30, 2001, a year beyond his retirement date.
Kuehn was named CEO in 1984, and saw Sonat through the process of withdrawing from the oil field service business and expanding oil and gas exploration and production, Sonat said in a statement.
In addition, the company said Donald Russell, chairman and chief executive officer of Sonat Exploration Co, was asked to remain with the company until January 1, 2000.
Russell was also promoted to the additional position of vice chairman of Sonat Inc, the company said.
